text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Italian Foreign Minister Lamberto Dini expected for a two-day visit to Morocco on July 16.
- King Hassan bestows decorations on athletes and presidents of sports federations.
- Professional banking association says it is considering reducing interest rates on loans following the government's request.
- Morocco looks into fee-paying secondary and higher education for households earning more than 4,500 dirhams ($465) per month.
- Socialism and Progress Party (SPP) told a news conference that it favoured proportional representation in future elections as the best way to ensure democracy.
- Privatisation Minister Abderrahman Saaidi starts visit to Spain over sale of state-owned firms and to outline opportunities to foreign investors.
